summary: Amdocs Limited filed a Form 6-K reporting Q3 fiscal 2026 results via press release and earnings presentation. The filing covers routine financials: revenue of $1.175 billion (up 2.7% YoY), GAAP diluted EPS of $0.59 including a restructuring charge, and non-GAAP diluted EPS of $1.84. It announces a multi-year strategic engagement with Liberty Latin America but provides no deal terms. The company repurchased $143 million of shares during the quarter. No special-situation event (merger, tender, spin-off, activist, etc.) is present; this is an ordinary earnings release, so it does not qualify as a special situation.
